mapper.select: select a.* from address a where user_id=#{userId}
select user_status from user where id = #{userId} for update
select count(*) from address where user_id = #{userId}
select id from address where user_id = #{userId} and id = #{addressId} for update
mapper.update: update address set default_flag = 0, update_time = current_timestamp where user_id = #{userId} and default_flag = 1
mapper.insert: insert into address (user_id, consignee_name, consignee_phone, province_name, city_name, region_name, detail_address, default_flag, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{consigneeName}, #{consigneePhone}, #{provinceName}, #{cityName}, #{regionName}, #{detailAddress}, #{defaultFlag}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp)
mapper.delete: delete from address where id=#{id} and user_id =#{userId}
